Aurora A1 - owner guide
Tire pressure
Check tire pressure when the tires are cold. The fictional Aurora A1 uses 2.4 bar for all four tires with a light load. Never use these invented values for a real vehicle.

Aurora A1 - owner guide
Coolant warning
If the coolant warning appears, stop safely and switch off the engine. Wait until the engine has cooled before checking the level. Do not open a hot cooling system.

Aurora A1 - owner guide
Service boundaries
This owner guide does not specify cylinder head bolt tightening torques or engine disassembly procedures. Contact a qualified workshop for repair instructions.
